summary: Validate token lifecycle operations for access and refresh tokens

scenarios.name: Generate and Refresh Access Token
scenarios.objective: Verify access token can be refreshed using refresh token
preconditions: Valid OTP generated and validated with profile
steps: Validate OTP via POST /validateOTP to obtain refresh token
scenarios.source_reference: UseCase1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx

scenarios.name: Revoke Refresh Token
scenarios.objective: Verify revoked refresh token cannot generate new access token
preconditions: Valid refresh token obtained from OTP validation
steps: Attempt to refresh access token using POST /token/refresh
scenarios.source_reference: UseCase1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx
